parent_protocol: joint_protocol_v4.json (immutable; v5 only subsamples within parent partitions)

workload.unit: Nominal task-artifact slots before identical-state reuse, NOT model calls or token/cost ceilings
workload.excluded: Shared evidence preparation, scorer setup, attribution details and optional extra studies are accounted separately

scope: One benchmark-agnostic, task-conditioned MAS generator per joint replicate; same frozen selected version on all six benchmarks
development_partition: None; unused tasks are not a development or replacement set

evolution.stores: One shared mutable experience store per replicate
evolution.order: Filter each frozen parent run order to selected sources; interleave RR, DSQA, WritingBench one each, five times per stage
evolution.updates: Direct per-source writes after structural/evidence checks; no accept/hold/reject gate
evolution.failure_policy: Consume each source position once; no replacement or quality resampling
evolution.continuation: Latest trajectory, no VAL rollback or early stopping
evolution.retrieval: Only the 60 global EVO task IDs may source shared experience; exclude VAL, TEST and unused

validation.scope: All fixed 30 VAL tasks at each of all five checkpoints, never a recent batch

native_score_normalization.researchrubrics: (score-L_t)/(U_t-L_t), theoretical per-task bounds fixed before responses; degenerate range maps to zero

validation.aggregation: Within-benchmark normalized task mean, then equal 1/3 benchmark weights
validation.missing: Observed score remains null; conservative normalized selector substitutes zero
validation.selection: All five checkpoints including C0; max utility (1e-12 tolerance), more completed slots, earlier position, lexical state hash
validation.isolation: Read-only snapshots, no experience writes or feedback to source actors or mid-run human tuning
validation.cache: Reuse identical state and execution identity observations, never resample for better VAL

universal_generator_release.checkpoint: Run 0 joint-VAL winner; no eligible state means no release
universal_generator_release.replicates: Report all three selected states; never select run or state using TEST
universal_generator_release.test_binding: Same selected state and generator/config hash across all six benchmarks within each run; only input/scoring adapters differ
universal_generator_release.not_claimed: Not new model weights, not a fixed team, not a completed evolved deployment

test.static_sharing: Each static baseline is generated once per task and shared across the three paired trajectory comparisons, not three independent observations
test.release_boundary: Seal all mandatory submissions across six benchmarks before any TEST scoring/feedback release
test.adaptation: No updates, target tuning, source switching, checker-guided repair or extra negotiation
test.unused: Never score or use for extra checkpoint selection without a versioned amendment

comparison.matching: Same backbone, task evidence and resource ceilings; actual cost reported separately

evaluation.researchrubrics: Pinned signed-weight native score on all 33 inherited clean TEST tasks
evaluation.deepsearchqa: Native task F1; precision, recall and fully-correct rate auxiliary
evaluation.writingbench: Native mean checklist score 1-10 per task, then task macro mean
evaluation.deepresearch_bench_ii: Native fraction of labels equal to 1; blocked-source rate separate; 20 en and 20 zh
evaluation.ifeval: Author prompt-level strict accuracy; loose/instruction-level auxiliary
evaluation.ifbench: Author prompt-level loose accuracy; strict/instruction-level auxiliary
evaluation.aggregate_policy: Report native benchmark metrics separately, never VAL utility as a leaderboard score
evaluation.uncertainty: Whole-task paired bootstrap 10000 and sign-flip 100000, seed 20261001; Holm within research/writing and instruction diagnostic families; report trajectory variation separately
evaluation.scope_limit: Small fixed subset study, not a full-benchmark or SOTA claim; no outcome-driven task replacement

runtime_status: Metadata preparation and selector are executable; legacy v3 per-benchmark runner is not a v5 joint runner
execution_profile: Retain configs/benchmark_suite_v3.yaml resource limits; scorer/model identities must be fixed in any real run bundle
